regulations.name: IEC 60601-1 Medical Electrical Equipment General Requirements
EN 60601-1 Medical Electrical Equipment General Requirements (European)
IEC 60529 Degrees of Protection Provided by Enclosures (IP Code)

tests.requirement: RISKS associated with pre-set controls addressed in RISK MANAGEMENT PROCESS when applicable as verified by review of RISK MANAGEMENT FILE
Actuating parts of controls of ME EQUIPMENT
Actuating parts cannot be pulled off or loosened up during NORMAL USE
Controls secured so that the indication of any scale always corresponds to the position of the control
Incorrect connection of indicating device to relevant component prevented by adequate construction when it could be separated without use of a TOOL
Torque values per Table 30 applied between control knob and shaft of rotating controls for not less than 2s, 10 times in each direction, knobs did not rotate
Tests conducted by applying an axial force of 60 N for electrical components and 100 N for other components for 1 min when an axial pull was required in NORMAL USE
Stops of adequate mechanical strength provided on rotating/movable parts of controls where necessary to prevent unexpected change from max to min
Torque values in Table 30 applied 10 times in each direction to rotating controls for 2 sec

No unexpected change of the controlled parameter resulted from the application of an axial force of 60 N for electrical components and 100 N for other components to rotating or movable parts of controls for 1 min
Cord-connected HAND-HELD and foot-operated control devices
HAND-HELD control devices of ME EQUIPMENT complied with 15.3.4.1
Foot-operated control device supported an actuating force of 1350 N for 1 min applied over an area of 30 mm diameter in its position of NORMAL USE with no damage
Control device of HAND-HELD and foot-operated control devices turned in all possible abnormal positions and placed on a flat surface; no unacceptable RISK caused by changing control setting
Foot-operated control device is at least IPX1 and complies with tests of IEC 60529
ENCLOSURE of foot operated control devices containing electrical circuits is at least IPX6 and complies with IEC 60529 if in NORMAL USE liquids are likely to be found
Aluminium wires less than 16 mm2 in cross-sectional area are not used
Oil container in PORTABLE ME EQUIPMENT allows for expansion of oil and is adequately sealed to prevent loss of oil in any position
Oil containers in MOBILE ME EQUIPMENT sealed to prevent loss of oil during transport
Partially sealed oil-filled ME EQUIPMENT and its parts provided with means for checking the oil level to detect leakage
MAINS SUPPLY TRANSFORMERS OF ME EQUIPMENT and transformers providing separation in accordance with 8.5
Overheating

semantic_fragments.content: Indicator lights provided on ME EQUIPMENT incorporating non-luminous heaters to indicate heaters are operational when a HAZARDOUS SITUATION could exist, except when apparent to OPERATOR from normal operating position. Result: No non-luminous heaters. Verdict: N/A. Requirement not applied to heated stylus-pens for recording purposes. Verdict: N/A. Indicator lights provided on ME EQUIPMENT to indicate an output exists where an accidental or prolonged operation of output circuit could constitute a HAZARDOUS SITUATION. Result: No such output. Verdict: N/A. Colours of indicator lights complied with 7.8.1. Verdict: N/A. Charging mode visibly indicated in ME EQUIPMENT incorporating a means for charging an INTERNAL ELECTRICAL POWER SOURCE. Verdict: N/A.

A pressure-release device operating during NORMAL USE is, optionally, provided for oil containers. ME EQUIPMENT and technical description examined, and manual tests conducted to confirm compliance with oil container requirements. All oil container related clauses (15.4.9) are N/A as there is no oil container in the device.
